title: Ladder: motor run feedback monitoring
summary: A contactor that is commanded but never confirms it pulled in is a fault. Watch the auxiliary contact with a TON box, latch a fault with a SET coil, switch the motor off, block restarts and let Stop acknowledge the fault with a RESET coil.
objectives: Detect a missing feedback signal with a TON box
Latch a diagnostic with SET and RESET coils
Interlock the motor against a latched fault
instructions: Keep the start/stop circuit with self-holding.
When MotorContactor is on and MotorFeedback has not confirmed for 1 s, set FeedbackFault with a SET coil.
While FeedbackFault is TRUE the motor is off and Start cannot restart it: add a normally closed contact on FeedbackFault to the motor rung.
Pressing Stop (StopPB FALSE) acknowledges the fault: a RESET coil on FeedbackFault.
RunLamp shows the confirmed running motor (MotorFeedback).
hints: Rung: MotorContactor (normally open), MotorFeedback (normally closed), TON with PT T#1s, then a SET coil on FeedbackFault.
A SET coil keeps its variable TRUE after power disappears; only a RESET coil clears it.
When SET and RESET of one variable are both powered in a scan, the later rung wins.

criteria.title: With feedback the motor keeps running
criteria.onFail: The motor was not running 3.5 s after Start although the feedback confirmed it.

criteria.title: No fault when the feedback confirms
criteria.onFail: FeedbackFault was set although MotorFeedback confirmed the contactor.

criteria.title: Start still energizes the contactor
criteria.onFail: The contactor was off 0.7 s after Start: the watch time is 1 s.

criteria.title: Missing feedback switches the motor off
criteria.onFail: The contactor stayed on although MotorFeedback never confirmed it.

criteria.title: The fault is latched
criteria.onFail: FeedbackFault was not TRUE after the feedback timeout.

criteria.title: Start cannot restart while the fault is latched
criteria.onFail: Start switched the contactor on again while FeedbackFault was latched.

criteria.title: Stop acknowledges; the repaired motor restarts
criteria.onFail: After the repair, Stop and Start, the motor did not run with FeedbackFault cleared.
